en.title: Longest Contiguous Range with a Sum Divisible by k
en.description:
Given an array of non-negative integers, find the length of the longest non-empty contiguous subarray whose sum is divisible by k; output 0 if there is none.

This site's standard input/output is stated explicitly; ranges not given by the source problem are marked as this site's conventions.
en.input: The first line contains n k, and the second line contains n integers. 1≤n≤100000, 0≤a[i]≤10⁹, 1≤k≤10⁹.
en.explanation: Example 1: 7, 6, 1, 4 sum to 18, giving length 4; there is no longer valid range. Example 2: the only element 1 is not divisible by 2, so the output is 0. Example 3: the whole range sums to 0, which is divisible by 7, so the output is 2.
hints: Record the first position where each prefix sum remainder appears; the range between two prefixes with the same remainder is valid.
